newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BOK says supplies 470 bln won to banks via repos.
newsitem.headline: BOK says supplies 470 bln won to banks via repos.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) on Monday supplied 470 billion won through overnight repurchase agreements to help ease fund shortages, a BOK official said.
The BOK official said the fund supply aimed to help banks meet the deadline for the central bank's twice-monthly review of won reserve cash obligations.
BOK reviews the won reserve levels on seventh and 22nd days of every month.
He said some of the repos were expected to be replaced with new ones to prevent any possible impact on the money market.
